mods.description: Draws one live line above the prompt per running subagent or background Bash command (up to 4, then `+N more · /radar`): a yellow ●, its description, `sub` or `sh`, elapsed time, a subagent's tool count and what it is doing now (reading, editing, searching, running…). Команда `/radar` открывает панель Agent Radar: 1–9 открывают последние сообщения агента или хвост вывода команды, b возвращает назад, c убирает завершённые, q закрывает.

mods.description: Adds a line under your status line from the `prompt_cache` figures Claude Code sends it. While warm: a green `cache ●` with the TTL (5m or 1h), a 10-cell bar, time left, hit rate and misses, yellow under 20% of the lifetime. Once cold: a red `cache ○ cold` with the tokens the next message re-caches and the last miss's cause. `/cache-clock setup` points `statusLine` at a Node script it copies to `~/.claude/cache-clock/`, which runs your own status line first, and sets `refreshInterval` to 30 s; `/cache-clock remove` puts your settings back; `/cache-clock` says whether it is on. mods.description_ru: Добавляет строку под вашей строкой статуса по данным `prompt_cache`, которые Claude Code ей передаёт. Пока кэш тёплый: зелёный `cache ●` со сроком жизни (5m или 1h), полоской из 10 клеток, оставшимся временем, долей попаданий и числом промахов; когда остаётся меньше 20% срока, строка желтеет. Когда кэш остыл: красный `cache ○ cold`, сколько токенов перекэширует следующее сообщение и причина последнего промаха. After about 50 idle minutes it sends a tiny request so the prompt cache stays warm (up to 3 times), then saves an away handoff summary: `/handoff resume` starts a new chat from it, `/handoff continue` stays. With `auto_handoff` on, at 600k tokens it writes a summary, runs /clear and continues in a new chat. It nudges Claude on repeated failures or 'done' without a check, and drafts tool-call guards that apply only after you approve. `/handoff` shows status, `/handoff panel` opens a tabbed panel above the prompt (not in VS Code).

mods.description: After each turn, the hint line under the prompt ends with that turn's tokens and the session's running total, in color: `↑` input (blue), `↓` output (green) and `cache` (Claude orange), the tokens read from or written to the prompt cache, then a dim `session ↑ … ↓ …` total of input and output.
